specifications.purpose: Color palette specification board showing all design_system.palette.tokens with hex values, usage roles, and contrast ratios
Material and finish specification board showing fabric weave samples, wood grain, soft-touch plastic, LED diffuser material
Visual language board showing the breathing-arc motif system: breath-ring arcs, pebble-curve silhouettes, warm-glow gradients
Industrial form language and design philosophy showing organic pebble metaphor, proportion studies, silhouette evolution
Functional mechanism overview showing speaker, microphone array, LED ring, touch button, charging base layout and working principles

deliverables.purpose: Form study showing 3-4 organic form variants explored as silhouette options
deliverables.acceptance_test: All forms are rounded with no sharp edges, non-animal, non-human, recognizable as a desktop companion device. Minimum corner radius 8mm visible in all variants.

deliverables.purpose: Selected form multi-angle view showing front, side, 45-degree top-down, and back views
deliverables.acceptance_test: 4 consistent views of same product. Height-to-width ratio 1.3-1.5:1. Base slightly narrower than body. No visible screws or seams on exterior.

deliverables.purpose: Mechanism overview with annotated diagram showing speaker, mic array, LED ring, button, and charging contacts placement
deliverables.acceptance_test: Clear functional zone labels. LED ring at upper third. Large button on front face. Speaker area behind fabric wrap. All annotations use text-charcoal on surface-cream.

deliverables.purpose: Ergonomic analysis showing elderly hand interaction, button reach, viewing angle comfort, and stability on surface
deliverables.acceptance_test: Shows elderly hand with warm skin tone touching device. Button diameter at least 25mm. Device height suitable for seated desk use. Clear dimension annotations.

deliverables.purpose: CMF board showing fabric weave texture, light oak wood, soft-touch matte plastic, and LED diffuser material samples
deliverables.acceptance_test: At least 4 material samples clearly shown. Colors reference design_system palette hex values. Warm tone unified across all samples. Each sample labeled with material name and finish.

deliverables.purpose: Production context showing modular structure with removable fabric cover, separable wood base, and assembly relationships
deliverables.acceptance_test: Shows fabric sleeve removable for washing. Wood base separable. Internal structure logical. Conveys maintainability design intent.

deliverables.purpose: Detail and connection close-ups showing button surface texture, LED light diffusion, fabric-to-plastic junction, and charging contacts
deliverables.acceptance_test: Macro view showing at least 3 details: button texture, LED glow diffusion, material transition. All transitions smooth with no sharp edges. Warm lighting throughout.

deliverables.purpose: Scale reference showing product alongside everyday objects like teacup, hand, and book to convey palm-sized scale
deliverables.acceptance_test: Product shown with at least 2 everyday objects for scale. Clearly conveys 120-150mm diameter. Visual weight suggests under 1kg. Warm domestic setting.

deliverables.purpose: Lifestyle context showing device in real home environment such as living room side table, bedroom nightstand, or study shelf
deliverables.acceptance_test: Device blends into warm home environment with 2700K warm light. Looks like decor not electronics. Elderly hands may appear but no faces shown. Kinfolk-style aesthetic.

deliverables.purpose: Exploded view showing internal structure layers: fabric shell, LED light guide ring, speaker module, mainboard, battery, and wood base
deliverables.acceptance_test: Clearly shows 5 or more structural layers. Explosion spacing is even. Each layer material is identifiable. Overall structure is logical and manufacturable.

deliverables.purpose: Gallery HTML page showcasing all design specifications and generated artifacts with design system overview
deliverables.acceptance_test: Valid HTML with sections for Design System, Design Specifications, and Generated Artifacts. Uses palette swatches from design_system.json. Responsive layout. No external dependencies.
